text:
Ava: FYI — I noticed a big jump in unbilled hosted usage for ACME this quarter. Looks like spot pricing credits didn't apply on several lines :eyes:. Anyone seen this?
Helena: Hmm can you paste the invoice/usage lines? I pulled today but might have missed a filter.
Ava: Sure — root invoice is INV-2026-4432, snippet below: 
```
2026-03-10  hosted-inference  acme@example.com  12,450 tokens  spot_credit=false  charge=12450.00
2026-03-12  hosted-inference  acme@example.com  8,200 tokens   spot_credit=false  charge=8200.00
```
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-4432 created (2026-03-15). Status: pending_payment. Tags: spot-pricing, acme.
Ravi: Thanks. Likely the pricing-experiment flag wasn't toggled on the billing backfill job. Could be the filter on region or plan mismatch. Do we know if these were within the experiment window?
Ava: They fall inside 2026-03-01..2026-03-14 experiment window per my notes.
Liam: From a revrec angle — if credits should've applied, revenue shouldn't be recognized at full amount. We should either issue a credit or book an accrual/reversal. What's our estimated exposure?
Helena: Running reconciliation now. Preliminary calc: total overstated charges = $20,650. I can open a credit memo but that will hit AR. If we want to close month, we could accrue a contra-revenue now and reverse when memos post.
Ravi: Recommendation: book an accrual for the overstated amount to be conservative, annotate with experiment ID PX-03-2026 and link to job run id. Then create credit memos once billing backfill finishes.
Ava: Agreed. Please include GL codes and approvals. Who signs off?
Liam: FP&A approves accrual. Use account 4002 (Deferred Revenue Contr.) and contra account 1201 (Accrued Credits). Add memo: "Acme spot pricing experiment mis-application — quarter-end accrual".
Helena: I'll create a journal and tag @Ravi for the experiment link. Journal: JE-2026-03-ACME-01 amount=20650.00 USD, reversing entry next month.
Ravi: I'll surface the experiment log and the backfill job run. Also will add a note to ops to prevent recurrence (fix filter).
Ava: Thanks team — please post the JE number and the credit memo ids when done. :thumbsup:
